resource_control.combining_datasets: Do not combine CPU16 diagnostic and CPU64 primary measurements in headline aggregates.

scope: One BF16 DeepGEMM SwiGLU layer plus afdEP communication; planned intra-original-request microbatches; no Attention compute, inter-request arrival-driven scheduler, full-model or serving claim.

timing.included: Runtime source staging, GPU live-count write, graph replays, output assembly, and request completion; request counts and repeats reported per job.
timing.order: Phase sweeps use three rotated orders. Matched C2 jobs use four balanced orders so each variant occupies every position once.
timing.excluded: Weights, resident input generation, startup allocations, standard-capacity warmup, capture, first graph replay, and independent reference computation.
timing.latency: First source staging CUDA event through last original-output assembly; maximum of four Attention GPU intervals for each original request; not host serving response latency.
timing.tails: Every request and repeat retained; no outlier removal. Throughput uses maximum rank whole-trace wall time, including runtime host overhead and drains.
timing.comparison: Paired by repeat within one job/configuration. Phase pipeline versus same-split serial controls partition, arena size, GEMM hint and graph phases. Consolidated pipeline_graph additionally changes submission, source staging order and request-boundary fork/join; its gain is not pure overlap. Cross-job, CPU-quota and traffic-class observations are not causal paired comparisons.

memory.registered_transport: Sum of native registered windows across all eight GPUs; separate from PyTorch; not total VRAM or allocated on every exchange.
memory.pytorch_active: Per-rank active/peak allocated bytes minus that rank's pre-workspace baseline. Baseline includes weights, resident source inputs/outputs and prepared reference tensors. Mean FFN is per GPU, not summed across ranks.
memory.slots: Whole graph owns one max-capacity slot; split serial and pipeline own identical two-slot capacities, independent arenas and shared weights. GEMM/GEMM overlap is disabled.

variants.pipeline_graph: C2 only; same two slots, one captured raw multistream fork/join DAG and one replay per original request.
variants.whole_graph: One graph, one full-capacity slot, serialized receive/GEMMs/reply.
variants.split_serial: Same balanced contiguous microbatches, two slots, fixed phase graphs, and GEMM hint as pipeline, with each chunk completed before next starts.
variants.pipeline: Source dispatches ahead before collecting; slot-specific receive/reply streams overlap one shared ordered GEMM stream; source drains each original request before dispatching the next.

provenance.validation_metadata_difference: Benchmark removed a redundant request-count field after validation; transport, ownership, GEMM implementation and validation code were unchanged.
